# Redblue benchmarks

Generated by `cargo run --bin rb-bench`. This checked-in baseline records the verified answer for each workload, not wall time: timings vary by machine and are written to the untracked `BENCH_TIMINGS.md` and printed to stdout instead. The answer column is verified by the harness before a row is written.

| Workload | Size | Answer |
|---|---:|---:|
| fibonacci | 20 | 6765 |
| primes | 1000 | 168 |
| concat | 200 |  |
| lex | 200 | 200 |

## Hardware

- CPU: AMD EPYC 7763 64-Core Processor (4 CPUs)
- Build: debug (`cargo run --bin rb-bench`), linux x86_64
